extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZT52C33 row was selected from the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The BZT52C33 row gives VZ minimum 31.35 V, nominal 33.0 V, and maximum 34.65 V at IZT = 2 mA; the nominal value and paired IZT are used for the zener breakdown fields.

The exact row gives maximum ZZT = 80 ohm at IZT = 2 mA, maximum ZZK = 325 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA, reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 23.1 V, and admissible IZM = 2 mA. Zener impedance, knee current, temperature coefficient, and admissible-current fields are not represented by the strict schema.

The forward-voltage maximum is 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from the p. 1 maximum-ratings table. No component-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published; the p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are grouped series-level characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C33 trace.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C33 trace labeled 33 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.
